name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
title: 5paisa Capital Ltd - 540776 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% YoY to INR 88.4 crore but management admits a soft quarter and ADTO dip in F&O; growth acceleration is promised without numbers.

triggers.label: Q1 moderation, F&O ADTO dip
triggers.quote: So, it is slightly one-off. I mean, overall revenue-wise, yes, we've grown.

triggers.label: Rights issue INR 468 cr deployed
triggers.quote: we have deployed capital first in exchange margin purpose, which is a INR 227 crore

guidance.quote: we do expect growth to accelerate from there

red_flags.label: Q1 slowdown, ADTO and acquisition tapering
red_flags.quote: this quarter has been kind of a bit slow

evasions.quote: for this quarter and forward looking, I don't want to make, but, again, see the ADTO growth

summary.headline: 5paisa Q1 FY27 revenue rose 14% YoY to INR 88.4 crore, PAT INR 11.6 crore; management flagged a slower quarter and expects growth to accelerate.
summary.overview: Total revenue grew 14% YoY to INR 88.4 crore and PAT was INR 11.6 crore, with customers at 52.6 lakh. The average client funding book (MTF plus T+5) was INR 422 crore, up 3% QoQ, and mutual fund AUM reached INR 2,073 crore, up 18% QoQ. Management said volatility in the prior quarter moderated activity in Q1, with F&O ADTO slightly down and cash ADTO up. The company deployed part of the INR 468 crore rights issue proceeds into exchange margin, loan repayment and general corporate purposes.

segments.name: Funding (MTF and T+5)
segments.commentary: T+5 extended to 2,500 eligible scrips at interest from 0.045% per day; MTF extended to 1,500 scrips with funding limits up to INR 25 crore. Management said MTF has roughly doubled over about 15 months, mainly from existing customers.

segments.name: F&O / derivatives
segments.commentary: F&O ADTO dipped slightly in Q1. New launches include OI profile on Charts, OneClick execution and AlgoSpace, an algo trading platform aimed at sachet- and packet-sized algos.

segments.name: Cash equities
segments.commentary: Cash ADTO grew in Q1 per management, with no quantified figure given.

segments.name: Wealth / mutual funds
segments.commentary: MF AUM reached INR 2,073 crore, up 18% QoQ; management cites portfolio building as the basis for sticky, high-LTV customers.

guidance_outlook: Management expects growth to accelerate from Q2 onwards, citing product revamp and growth marketing; no numeric guidance given.
Product platform upgrades and a complete revamp are expected to move to production in the next few months.
Over the next 12 months the focus is on engagement, adoption and monetisation of new app rollouts, plus unit-economics improvement to reach operating leverage.
Rights issue capital to fund product and tech talent, partnerships and growth marketing; inorganic opportunities being evaluated selectively.
Third-party distribution: no in the very near term; may be considered in the medium term, with product adjacencies (LAS) first.
capex_capacity: Rights issue proceeds of INR 468 crore: INR 227 crore to exchange margin (RBI ended broker intraday facility from 1 July), about INR 150 crore to repay bank loans and CPs, and INR 88 crore general corporate purposes.
Management says the company is positioned to deploy capital into product, tech, and growth marketing, with no capex figures disclosed.
Customer acquisition channel mix to shift toward quality organic and paid, adjusted quarterly on CAC and RPC by channel.
demand_pricing: Management said revenue per customer (RPC) rose in recent months and in the latest quarter, and LTV is improving.
F&O-heavy customer base was hit by market volatility; management cited moderation across industry since F&O changes in October 2024.
Market share: management said some players gained and some lost share; said it is hard to attribute customer moves between firms.
Management is prioritising quality over headline customer additions; no CAC figures were disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q1 slowdown a one-off, and will growth pick up from Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 saw moderation with some spillover from recent volatility; it expects growth to accelerate from here, driven by product and growth marketing.

qa_highlights.question: Why has ADTO growth and customer acquisition tapered?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is focusing on quality acquisition, with RPC and LTV improving over recent months; ADTO depends on average order value and long-term customers.

qa_highlights.question: How will the INR 468 crore rights issue be deployed?
qa_highlights.answer: INR 227 crore to exchange margin, about INR 150 crore to bank and CP loan repayment, and INR 88 crore general corporate purposes (product, tech, marketing).

qa_highlights.question: What needs to change for revenue to grow at a healthy clip after three flat years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management pointed to the revamped product, increased growth marketing, and new revenue lines in the pipeline, alongside MTF traction.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company start third-party distribution like IIFL Securities?
qa_highlights.answer: Not in the near term; it may be considered in the medium to long term, with core-adjacent products such as MTF and LAS first.

risks_watch: Q1 slowdown in ADTO and customer acquisition; management has not quantified the recovery path.
Competition from large scaled-up players; market share shifts were acknowledged but not quantified.
Execution risk on the platform revamp and the AI and MCP initiatives, which were still in beta.
Exchange margin and funding requirements after RBI ended broker intraday facility from 1 July.
Reliance on F&O revenue, which dipped in Q1.
summary.management_tone: Confident on product and long-term opportunity, but candid that Q1 was slower and that volatility spilled over. Answers on ADTO and customer metrics were qualitative and deflected to RPC and LTV, with no quantified guidance.
key_quotes: So, it is slightly one-off. I mean, overall revenue-wise, yes, we've grown.
So, our focus is that we are able to also bring in a higher number of customers with higher quality.
So, I do believe that from these quarters on, we can see an acceleration in growth.

growth.why: Management expects growth to accelerate from Q2 onwards, backed by product revamp, new app rollouts and growth marketing, but gave no numeric guidance and no quantified capacity or orders; Q1 revenue grew 14% YoY while F&O ADTO dipped slightly.
